class.name: OcgGpElips2d
class.brief_description: Describes an ellipse in the plane (2D space). An ellipse is defined by its major and minor radii and positioned in the plane with a coordinate system (a gp_Ax22d object) as follows: - the origin of the coordinate system is the center of the ellipse, - its "X Direction" defines the major axis of the ellipse, and - its "Y Direction" defines the minor axis of the ellipse. This coordinate system is the "local coordinate system" of the ellipse. Its orientation (direct or indirect) gives an implicit orientation to the ellipse. class.description: ! Describes an ellipse in the plane (2D space). ! An ellipse is defined by its major and minor radii and ! positioned in the plane with a coordinate system (a ! gp_Ax22d object) as follows: ! - the origin of the coordinate system is the center of the ellipse, ! - its "X Direction" defines the major axis of the ellipse, and ! - its "Y Direction" defines the minor axis of the ellipse. ! This coordinate system is the "local coordinate system" ! of the ellipse. Its orientation (direct or indirect) gives an ! implicit orientation to the ellipse. In this coordinate ! system, the equation of the ellipse is: ! @code ! X*X / (MajorRadius**2) + Y*Y / (MinorRadius**2) = 1.0 ! @endcode ! See Also ! gce_MakeElips2d which provides functions for more ! complex ellipse constructions ! Geom2d_Ellipse which provides additional functions for ! constructing ellipses and works, in particular, with the ! parametric equations of ellipses

method.name: gp_Elips2d
method.description: Creates an indefinite ellipse.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Modifies this ellipse, by redefining its local coordinate system so that - its origin becomes theP.

method.name: SetMajorRadius
method.description: Changes the value of the major radius. Raises ConstructionError if theMajorRadius < MinorRadius.

method.name: SetMinorRadius
method.description: Changes the value of the minor radius. Raises ConstructionError if MajorRadius < theMinorRadius or MinorRadius < 0.0

method.name: SetAxis
method.description: Modifies this ellipse, by redefining its local coordinate system so that it becomes theA.

method.name: SetXAxis
method.description: Modifies this ellipse, by redefining its local coordinate system so that its origin and its "X Direction" become those of the axis theA. The "Y Direction" is then recomputed. The orientation of the local coordinate system is not modified.

method.name: SetYAxis
method.description: Modifies this ellipse, by redefining its local coordinate system so that its origin and its "Y Direction" become those of the axis theA. The "X Direction" is then recomputed. The orientation of the local coordinate system is not modified.

method.name: Area
method.description: Computes the area of the ellipse.

method.name: Coefficients
method.description: Returns the coefficients of the implicit equation of the ellipse. theA * (X**2) + theB * (Y**2) + 2*theC*(X*Y) + 2*theD*X + 2*theE*Y + theF = 0.

method.name: Directrix1
method.description: This directrix is the line normal to the XAxis of the ellipse in the local plane (Z = 0) at a distance d = MajorRadius / e from the center of the ellipse, where e is the eccentricity of the ellipse. This line is parallel to the "YAxis". The intersection point between directrix1 and the "XAxis" is the location point of the directrix1. This point is on the positive side of the "XAxis".

method.name: Directrix2
method.description: This line is obtained by the symmetrical transformation of "Directrix1" with respect to the minor axis of the ellipse.

method.name: Eccentricity
method.description: Returns the eccentricity of the ellipse between 0.0 and 1.0 If f is the distance between the center of the ellipse and the Focus1 then the eccentricity e = f / MajorRadius. Returns 0 if MajorRadius = 0.

method.name: Focal
method.description: Returns the distance between the center of the ellipse and focus1 or focus2.

method.name: Focus1
method.description: Returns the first focus of the ellipse. This focus is on the positive side of the major axis of the ellipse.

method.name: Focus2
method.description: Returns the second focus of the ellipse. This focus is on the negative side of the major axis of the ellipse.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the center of the ellipse.

method.name: MajorRadius
method.description: Returns the major radius of the Ellipse.

method.name: MinorRadius
method.description: Returns the minor radius of the Ellipse.

method.name: Parameter
method.description: Returns p = (1 - e * e) * MajorRadius where e is the eccentricity of the ellipse. Returns 0 if MajorRadius = 0

method.name: Axis
method.description: Returns the major axis of the ellipse.

method.name: XAxis
method.description: Returns the major axis of the ellipse.

method.name: YAxis
method.description: Returns the minor axis of the ellipse. Reverses the direction of the circle.

method.name: IsDirect
method.description: Returns true if the local coordinate system is direct and false in the other case.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a ellipse with respect to the point theP which is the center of the symmetry

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a ellipse with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales a ellipse. theS is the scaling value.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms an ellipse with the transformation theT from class Trsf2d.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates a ellipse in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates a ellipse from the point theP1 to the point theP2.
